start: A gym member: a workout is open; the phone's storage is full

steps.action: Log a set
user_sees: Banner at the top of every screen: 'Couldn't save — your phone's storage may be full. Free some space; we'll keep trying.'
must_not: An error code or technical text
The set vanishing from the open workout

steps.action: Tap Minimise or the back arrow that sits under the banner
user_sees: The button under the banner works
must_not: The banner taking the tap

steps.action: Free some space on the phone and come back
user_sees: The banner goes by itself on the next good save; the workout has every set
must_not: The banner staying after saves work again
A lost or doubled set

tests.checks: s1 see (data only): storage full gives the storage line (315-331, 400-413); s1 not set vanishing / s3 see: the retry clears the banner and the set is kept (333-338)
s2 see/not (source read): the banner lets taps through and has nothing to press (13-22)
s1 see (data only): storage full gives the storage line (315-331, 400-413); s1 not set vanishing / s3 see: the retry clears the banner and the set is kept (333-338)
s2 see/not (source read): the banner lets taps through and has nothing to press (13-22)

start: A gym member: a workout is open; saving fails for a reason other than full storage

steps.action: Log a set
user_sees: Banner: 'Couldn't save your workout. We'll keep trying.'
must_not: Words about full storage when storage is not the cause
No sign at all that the save failed

steps.action: Wait while the app tries again
user_sees: The banner goes on the first good save
must_not: The app giving up for good
Tries so often that the workout screen stutters

tests.checks: s1 see/not (data only): any other error gives the general line, not the storage words (400-413); s2 not stutters: retries back off from 2 s to 30 s (415-418)
s1 see/not (data only): any other error gives the general line, not the storage words (400-413); s2 not stutters: retries back off from 2 s to 30 s (415-418)

start: A gym member: a workout is open and Finish fails; or a past workout is being edited and Save changes fails

steps.action: Tap Finish while saving fails
user_sees: Banner: 'Couldn't finish your workout. It's still open — tap Finish again.' (with full storage: '... free some space, then tap Finish again.')
must_not: The workout shown as finished
The workout closed and lost

steps.action: Tap Save changes on an edited workout while saving fails
user_sees: Banner: 'Couldn't save your changes. They're still open — tap Save changes again.'
must_not: The edit screen closing as if saved

steps.action: Tap Finish again once saving works
user_sees: The workout is finished once; the banner goes
must_not: Two copies of the workout

tests.checks: s1 see/not (data only): a failed Finish keeps the workout open, nothing saved, Finish line shown, full-storage variant (341-397); s3: the next Finish clears it
s1 see/not on the phone: the Finish line shows and the workout is still open with both sets (1-66)
s3 see/not on the phone: finished once, no Finish banner left, saved exactly once (1-55)
s1 see/not (data only): a failed Finish keeps the workout open, nothing saved, Finish line shown, full-storage variant (341-397); s3: the next Finish clears it
s1 see/not on the phone: the Finish line shows and the workout is still open with both sets (1-66)
s3 see/not on the phone: finished once, no Finish banner left, saved exactly once (1-55)

start: A gym member: a workout is open; saving works

steps.action: Log sets, finish the workout
user_sees: No banner at any time
must_not: The banner flashing on a save that worked

steps.action: While the banner shows, tap the banner itself
user_sees: Nothing happens; it has no buttons
must_not: The tap lost when a button sits under the banner
A hidden action

tests.checks: s1 see (data only): after a save that worked the banner state is empty (315-320)
s2 see/not (source read): no buttons, taps pass through (13-22)
s1 see (data only): after a save that worked the banner state is empty (315-320)
s2 see/not (source read): no buttons, taps pass through (13-22)

start: A gym member: a workout is open; Finish has failed and autosave is failing too

steps.action: Look at the banner
user_sees: The Finish line: 'Couldn't finish your workout. It's still open — tap Finish again.'
must_not: Two banners on top of each other

steps.action: Saving starts to work again
user_sees: The Finish line stays (it still needs a tap)
must_not: The banner going, leaving a workout the member thinks is finished

steps.action: Discard the workout, or finish it
user_sees: The banner goes
must_not: The banner left over every screen with no workout open

tests.checks: s2 see/not (data only): later autosaves keep the Finish line (386-392); s3 see: discarding the workout clears the banner (394-396); Finish plus a FAILING autosave is not tested
